shots.content_purpose: Preserved opening: the dark interior and the curtain-opening action of Video 1, establishing the light that the window view continues from.
shots.description: The video opens on the preserved dark interior of <Video 1>: the figure with long dark hair falling over the shoulders and dark clothing stands centered in near-black silhouette, facing dark curtains that hang with only a narrow vertical strip of daylight between them. The figure grips both curtain edges at chest height and pulls them apart; the vertical gap widens steadily into a bright strip that catches the fabric edges and the rim of the hair while the face stays unreadable in the low-key and cold light, and the camera holds a locked medium framing. Soft fabric sliding accompanies the pull.

shots.content_purpose: Preserved cut to the wide window view, now showing the Image 1 skyline through the retained glass.
shots.description: At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to the wide view through the window. Beyond the glass stands <Subject 1>: the beige central tower rises in front of the tree canopy with the green glass complex and its dark sign-bearing tower to the right, the white residential towers receding far left, the canopy band running unbroken across the midground, and the road with lamp posts below under blue sky with scattered clouds and bright daylight. The window of <Subject 2> keeps its frame edges, glass and perspective over this view, its oblique streak reflections passing across the skyline as the camera drifts slightly with small amplitude at slow speed. The replacement skyline stays stable and fully readable through the glass until the video ends at 00:06.000.
